item.title: 22nd IFAA Congress in Melbourne, Australia
item.description: Hosted by the Australian and New Zealand Association of Clinical Anatomists (ANZACA) the flagship event of the IFAA will be held in Australia for the first time. The 22nd IFAA Congress (13-16 August 2026) will be held in Melbourne at the world-class, award-winning Melbourne Convention and Exhibition Centre (MCEC). Situated right in heart of the […]

item.title: Final Call: IFAA Emergent Anatomists Award for the IFAA 2026 Congress (Closes February 28)
item.description: Applications for the IFAA EMERGENT ANATOMISTS’ INCENTIVE AWARD to attend the 22nd IFAA Congress (Melbourne, Australia), August 13-16, 2026 are still open and will close on February 28th, 2026. We particularly encourage applications from PhD students. For more details and the application form, please visit the award website.
